Versace Eros Eau de Toilette in a generous 200ml bottle is a men’s fragrance built on contrast: cool mint and zesty Italian lemon against candied apple and a soft vanilla base. Geranium and clary sage sit in the middle, giving it an aromatic, slightly herbal edge.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Italian Lemon, Mandarin, Mint, Candied Apple
  • Heart notes: Geranium, Clary Sage, AmberMax
  • Base notes: Atlas Cedarwood, Virginia Cedarwood, Vetiver, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Vanilla

How it wears

The mint and apple make it lively and sweet at first, and two cedarwoods with vetiver and sandalwood give it a sturdy, woody finish. It suits nights out, parties and date nights, and the eau de toilette strength keeps it wearable in the day too. The large size makes sense if this is your everyday scent.

Good to know

  • 200ml spray
  • Eau de toilette
  • Made for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Eros Parfum or Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum

Versace Eros Parfum is the parfum strength of Eros for men, a darker and more resinous take with lavender, geranium and benzoin at its core. Italian lemon, mandarin and black pepper open it, and a base of vanilla, patchouli and vetiver gives it a smooth, warm finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Italian Lemon, Italian Mandarin, Litsea Cubeba, Elemi, Black Pepper
  • Heart notes: Pomarose, Egyptian Geranium, Lavender, Clary Sage
  • Base notes: Benzoin, Cashmeran, Indonesian Patchouli, Vanilla, Haitian Vetiver

How it wears

A parfum holds a higher share of fragrance oils than an eau de toilette or eau de parfum, so it feels richer and closer to the skin. Elemi and pepper add a spicy lift, while benzoin and cashmeran keep things soft. It is at its best in the evening and through autumn and winter, for dinners and special occasions.

Good to know

  • Available in 100ml and 200ml
  • Parfum
  • Made for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Eros Eau de Toilette or Bvlgari Man in Black

Paco Rabanne 1 Million Eau de Toilette is a spicy, warm fragrance for men, here in a generous 200ml bottle. Blood mandarin, grapefruit and mint give it a bright, fresh opening, cinnamon and rose bring spice to the heart, and the base is rich with amber, leather, woody notes and Indian patchouli.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Blood Mandarin, Grapefruit, Mint
  • Heart notes: Cinnamon, Rose, Spicy Notes
  • Base notes: Amber, Leather, Woody Notes, Indian Patchouli

How it wears

The citrus and mint are lively at first, then cinnamon and leather take over for a sweet, spiced, confident character. It shines on nights out, at parties and in colder weather, and the eau de toilette strength keeps it wearable in daylight too. The large size suits anyone who reaches for the 1 Million eau de toilette most days.

Good to know

  • 200ml bottle
  • Eau de toilette
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Antonio Banderas Diavolo

Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette is a fresh, woody scent for men, here in a generous 200ml bottle. Grapefruit, mandarin orange and sea notes give it a bright, marine start, while ambergris, guaiac wood, oakmoss and patchouli form the base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Sea Notes, Grapefruit, Mandarin Orange
  • Heart notes: Bay Leaf, Jasmine
  • Base notes: Ambergris, Guaiac Wood, Oakmoss, Patchouli

How it wears

An eau de toilette is a lighter concentration than an eau de parfum, which suits a scent built on citrus and sea air. The herbal bay leaf and a touch of jasmine sit between the zesty top and the darker woods, so it never feels thin. It is a natural pick for everyday wear, the office and summer days, and the large bottle makes sense if this is your daily scent.

Good to know

  • 200ml spray
  • Eau de toilette
  • Made for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Invictus Eau de Toilette Gift Set or Azzaro Chrome Legend

Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum Spray is the parfum version of Phantom for men, here in a 15ml spray that slips easily into a bag or jacket pocket. Bright cardamom, bergamot, lemon and rhubarb open onto a lavender and geranium heart, then settle into vanilla, tolu balsam and vetiver. It is an aromatic scent with a soft, warm finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Cardamom, Bergamot, Lemon, Rhubarb
  • Heart notes: Lavender, Geranium, Patchouli, Cedar
  • Base notes: Vanilla, Tolu Balsam, Vetiver

How it wears

A parfum holds more fragrance oil than an eau de toilette, so the lavender and vanilla come through with a richer, rounder feel. The citrus and rhubarb keep the start lively enough for the office, while the balsamic base suits cooler evenings and nights out. The small size makes it handy for travel or for trying the Paco Rabanne Phantom parfum before a larger bottle.

Good to know

  • 15ml spray
  • Parfum
  • Made for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum or Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory

Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum is a warm, woody floral for women, in a refillable bottle. It is built on just three notes: jasmine sambac, cashmeran wood and white amber. The result is radiant and solar, with the jasmine wrapped in a soft, woody warmth. Choose the 30ml to get to know it, or the 90ml if it is already your signature, and refill the bottle when it runs out rather than buying a new one.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Jasmine sambac
  • Heart notes: Cashmeran wood
  • Base notes: White amber

How it wears

With so few notes, every one is clear: bright jasmine at first, then a smooth, slightly powdery wood and a glowing amber finish. It feels like a statement scent, ideal for evenings, celebrations and colder weather. The eau de parfum concentration gives it a deep, rich presence on skin.

Good to know

  • Available in 30ml and 90ml
  • Eau de parfum
  • Refillable bottle
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Mugler Angel or Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte

Paco Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum Intense is a richer, creamier version of Fame for women, in a 30ml bottle. Coconut water, pink pepper and bergamot give it a fresh, slightly spiced start, the heart blends jasmine, incense and ylang-ylang, and sandalwood, cedarwood and musk form the base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Coconut Water, Pink Pepper, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Jasmine, Incense, Ylang-Ylang
  • Base notes: Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Musk

How it wears

Coconut water brings a soft, milky freshness, while incense and ylang-ylang give the flowers more depth than the original. The woody, musky base makes it a good match for evenings, cooler days and occasions where you want something a little warmer. The 30ml size is a sensible way to own the Fame eau de parfum intense without committing to a big bottle.

Good to know

  • 30ml bottle
  • Eau de parfum intense
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Fame Eau de Parfum Refillable 80ml or Olympéa Flora Eau de Parfum Intense

Paco Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum is a floral fragrance for women that opens on juicy mango and bergamot before settling into something warmer and softer. This is the refillable 80ml bottle, so the same bottle can be refilled rather than replaced. Jasmine and olibanum sit at its heart, with vanilla and sandalwood underneath.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Mango, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Jasmine, Olibanum
  • Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood

How it wears

The fruit at the start is bright and sunny, then the jasmine and the resinous olibanum give it a smoother, slightly incensed middle. The vanilla and sandalwood dry-down is creamy rather than sweet, which makes it easy to wear from daytime into the evening. As an eau de parfum it carries more fragrance oil than an eau de toilette, so the warmer notes come through clearly.

Good to know

  • 80ml refillable spray bottle
  • Eau de parfum
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Fame Eau de Parfum Gift Set or Olympéa Flora Eau de Parfum Intense

In a 10ml size that slips into a bag, Paco Rabanne Fame Parfum is the parfum concentration of Fame for women. Mango, pink pepper and bergamot lead into jasmine, patchouli and frankincense, and the base of benzoin, sandalwood and musk gives it a warm, resinous finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Mango, Pink Pepper, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Jasmine, Patchouli, Frankincense
  • Base notes: Benzoin, Sandalwood, Musk

How it wears

Compared with a lighter spray, a parfum is the most concentrated form of a scent, and here that shows in the deeper heart: patchouli and frankincense add an earthy, smoky edge to the jasmine. The pink pepper keeps the opening lively, while benzoin and musk round everything off softly. It suits evenings, cooler months and occasions when you want a richer floral.

Good to know

  • 10ml spray, a handy travel or handbag size
  • Parfum
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Fame Eau de Parfum Refillable 80ml or Fame Eau de Parfum & Parfum Mini Set

Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum is a spicy, woody scent for men with a surprising floral side. Pink pepper, pear, Indonesian nutmeg, elemi and bergamot make a lively opening. Rose, clove, magnolia and flax sit in the heart, over Haitian vetiver, cashmeran, sandalwood, amber and sylkolide.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Pink pepper, pear, Indonesian nutmeg, elemi, bergamot
  • Heart notes: Rose, clove, magnolia, flax
  • Base notes: Haitian vetiver, cashmeran, sandalwood, amber, sylkolide

How it wears

Rose is not the usual note in a men's fragrance, and here the clove and pepper give it a confident, modern twist. The woods and amber make it warm, so it comes into its own in cooler months, on evenings out and at parties. Being an eau de parfum, it has a rich, full character from first spray to dry-down.

Good to know

  • Available in 5ml and 100ml
  • Eau de parfum
  • Made for men
  • The 5ml size is a good way to try it first
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Antonio Banderas Diavolo or Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense

Mugler Angel Eau de Parfum in 25ml is a sweet gourmand for women, where fruit and candy meet chocolate and patchouli. The top is playful, with cotton candy, coconut, cassis, melon, pineapple, bergamot, mandarin orange and jasmine. Honey, red berries, plum, apricot, peach and flowers fill the heart, and the base is rich with caramel, vanilla and tonka.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Cotton candy, coconut, cassis, melon, jasmine, bergamot, pineapple, mandarin orange
  • Heart notes: Honey, red berries, blackberry, plum, apricot, peach, jasmine, orchid, caraway, nutmeg, rose, lily of the valley
  • Base notes: Patchouli, chocolate, caramel, vanilla, tonka bean, amber, musk, sandalwood

How it wears

The contrast between the sugary notes and the earthy patchouli is what gives this scent its character. It is a bold choice for winter nights, parties and special occasions. If you like dessert-like fragrances with real depth, this is one to try.

Good to know

  • 25ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion or Mugler Alien

Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum is a bright, honeyed floral for women, and this 15ml spray is a neat way to carry it with you. Raspberry, neroli and Amalfi lemon open it, a bouquet of jasmine, African orange flower and gardenia follows, and white honey, patchouli and amber sit in the base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Raspberry, Neroli, Amalfi Lemon
  • Heart notes: Jasmine, African Orange Flower, Gardenia
  • Base notes: White Honey, Patchouli, Amber

How it wears

The raspberry and lemon make the first spray sparkle, then the white flowers bring a full, sunny feel. White honey gives the dry-down its golden sweetness, with patchouli and amber keeping it from turning sugary. It is a confident floral for parties, nights out and celebrations, and the small size is ideal for a handbag or as a gift.

Good to know

  • 15ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Fame Eau de Parfum or Olympéa Flora Eau de Parfum Intense

This 10ml bottle of Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey is a fresh eau de toilette for men, built on sea salt and ginger. Underneath, vetiver and sand vetiver give it a dry, mineral feel, and cedarwood with oakmoss ground it. The small size makes it easy to carry or to try before a bigger bottle.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Sea salt, ginger
  • Heart notes: Vetiver, sand vetiver
  • Base notes: Cedarwood, oakmoss

How it wears

Salt and ginger make a bright, slightly spicy start that suits warm days, the gym bag or a trip to the coast. The vetiver and moss bring a greener, earthier side as it settles, so it also works for the office. An eau de toilette is a lighter concentration, which keeps the whole thing crisp rather than heavy.

Good to know

  • 10ml spray
  • Eau de toilette
  • Made for men
  • A handy size for a bag, a gym kit or travel
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Bentley Silverlake or Azzaro Chrome Legend

Versace Yellow Diamond Eau de Toilette is a sunny floral for women, opening with citron, pear sorbet, neroli and bergamot. The heart is soft and airy with water lily, freesia, orange blossom and mimosa, and amber wood, palo santo and musk sit quietly underneath.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Citron, Pear Sorbet, Neroli, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Water Lily, Freesia, Orange Blossom, Mimosa
  • Base notes: Amber Wood, Palo Santo, Musk

How it wears

Light, fruity and a little powdery from the mimosa, it feels cheerful rather than heavy. It is a natural fit for spring and summer, daytime plans and the office. The pale woods and musk in the base keep it gentle as the day goes on, so it is an easy scent to reach for every morning.

Good to know

  • 90ml spray
  • Eau de toilette
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Eros Pour Femme miniature or Al Haramain L’Aventure Blanche

For women who like a little spice with their flowers, Paco Rabanne Ultraviolet Eau de Parfum pairs pepper, pimento and coriander with soft apricot and almond. Violet, osmanthus, rose and jasmine form the heart, and a base of amber, vanilla, patchouli and cedar gives it warmth. It comes in an 80ml bottle.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Pepper, Apricot, Coriander, Almond, Pimento
  • Heart notes: Violet, Osmanthus, Japanese Osmanthus, Rose, Jasmine
  • Base notes: Amber, Vanilla, Patchouli, Cedar

How it wears

The peppery opening is quickly softened by fruit and almond, then the violet and osmanthus give it a powdery floral middle. Amber and vanilla make it a warm, cosy choice for autumn and winter, dinners and evenings out. On a cool day it also works as a signature scent for everyday wear.

Good to know

  • 80ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion or Chloé Nomade Nuit d’Égypte

Fresh and fruity, Mugler Angel Nova Eau de Toilette is a women's fragrance built around lychee and rose. Bergamot adds a sparkling citrus edge at the start, magnolia softens the heart, and akigalawood with amberwood gives it a smooth woody base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Lychee, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Rose, Magnolia
  • Base notes: Akigalawood, Amberwood

How it wears

This is a lighter, more playful take than the deeper Angel scents, with juicy fruit and pink-toned florals up front. An eau de toilette is generally lighter in concentration than an eau de parfum, so it suits daytime, the office and spring or summer weekends. The woody drydown keeps it from feeling too sugary, and it layers easily under a light jacket on a cool spring evening.

Good to know

  • 50ml bottle
  • Eau de toilette
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Mugler Angel Elixir or Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Together

Warmer and deeper than the original Invictus, Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Eau de Parfum Extrême is an amber fragrance for men. Pink pepper and lemon give a crisp start, olibanum and lavender form the heart, and vanilla, tonka bean and amber make a smooth, sweet base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Pink Pepper, Lemon
  • Heart notes: Olibanum, Lavender
  • Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber

How it wears

The lemon fades quickly into a resinous, incense-like olibanum softened by aromatic lavender. From there the vanilla and tonka take over, giving it a cosy, slightly gourmand finish. As an eau de parfum extrême it is a richer take than a standard eau de toilette, and it shows in how present the vanilla and amber feel. This is a scent for evenings out, autumn and winter, and dressier occasions rather than a hot summer afternoon.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum extrême
  • Made for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum or Bvlgari Man in Black

Versace Man Eau Fraîche is a crisp, citrus-led eau de toilette for men, offered here as a 5ml miniature. White lemon, rosewood and star fruit open it, tarragon, cedar leaves and clary sage bring a green, herbal middle, and musk, amber and sycamore wood round it off.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: White Lemon, Rosewood, Carambola (Star Fruit)
  • Heart notes: Tarragon, Cedar Leaves, Clary Sage
  • Base notes: Musk, Amber, Sycamore Wood

How it wears

Clean and airy, it is made for hot days, holidays and mornings after the gym. The herbs and woods stop it feeling thin, so it is just as comfortable at a desk as on a beach. Its tiny size fits a pocket or travel washbag and suits anyone trying the scent for the first time.

Good to know

  • 5ml miniature
  • Eau de toilette
  • Made for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Azzaro Chrome Legend or Bentley Silverlake

Narciso Rodriguez All of Me is a soft floral eau de parfum for women, opening on magnolia. Rose and geranium Bourbon form the heart, and musk sits in the base alongside creamy sandalwood.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Magnolia
  • Heart notes: Rose, Geranium Bourbon
  • Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood

How it wears

Clean, rosy and close to the skin in feel, it is the kind of floral that works from morning meetings through to dinner. Geranium gives the rose a slightly green, fresh lift, while musk and sandalwood keep the finish smooth. This Narciso Rodriguez All of Me eau de parfum suits every season, and is an easy everyday signature for anyone who prefers a quiet, polished floral to a heavy, sweet one.

Good to know

  • 90ml bottle
  • Eau de parfum
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Narciso Rodriguez Musc Noir Rose For Her or Narciso Rodriguez Pure Musc For Her

Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Eau de Toilette Refillable is a fresh, clean scent for men in a 75ml bottle that can be refilled. Cool cucumber and melon meet mandarin orange at the start, with basil, sage and geranium in the heart. Musk, woodsy notes and suede give it a smooth, soft finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Cucumber, Melon, Mandarin Orange
  • Heart notes: Basil, Sage, Geranium
  • Base notes: Musk, Woodsy Notes, Suede

How it wears

This is an airy, watery fragrance with a green herbal edge from the basil and sage. An eau de toilette is lighter than an eau de parfum, which suits warm weather, the gym bag and long office days. The suede base keeps it from feeling too sharp, so it is easy to wear at any time of year.

Good to know

  • 75ml refillable bottle
  • Eau de toilette
  • Made for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Ralph Lauren Polo Cologne Intense or Azzaro Chrome Legend

Citrus and Mediterranean greenery set the tone of Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Eau de Parfum, a women's fragrance in a 100ml bottle. Citrus notes, mandarin orange and bergamot open it brightly, with jasmine at the centre. Cypress, pine tree and laurel in the base give it a fresh, woody, almost outdoor character.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Citrus Notes, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Jasmine
  • Base notes: Cypress, Pine Tree, Laurel

How it wears

Clean and sunny, it feels at home on summer days, holidays and garden lunches. The jasmine adds a gentle floral softness, while the cypress and laurel keep it crisp rather than sweet. An easy choice for daytime and the office if you prefer fresh scents to heavy ones. On cooler days the pine and cypress give it a little more weight.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Roberto Cavalli Paradiso Assoluto or Just Cavalli for Her

Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a bright women’s fragrance that starts with Sicilian lemon, Calabrian bergamot and pomegranate before opening into a heart of jasmine sambac, lemon flower and peony. Sandalwood, amber and musk give it a soft, warm base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Sicilian Lemon, Calabrian Bergamot, Pomegranate
  • Heart notes: Lemon Flower, Jasmine Sambac, Jasmine, Peony
  • Base notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Musk, Sensual Woods

How it wears

The citrus keeps it fresh and sparkling at first, then the jasmine and peony make it feel feminine and polished. As an eau de parfum it has a richer feel than an eau de toilette, so it works for evenings and occasions as well as spring and summer days. It is a good pick for weddings, dinners and celebrations.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de parfum
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Acqua di Parma Rosa Nobile or DKNY Be Delicious duo

Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Toilette comes here as a 5ml miniature, a fruity floral for women with raspberry sorbet and white currant over Sicilian lemon and mandarin. Freesia, magnolia and jasmine petals form the heart, resting on ambrox, white patchouli and musk.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Sicilian Lemon, Mandarin, Raspberry Sorbet, White Currant
  • Heart notes: Freesia, Magnolia, Jasmine Petals, Orange Blossom
  • Base notes: Ambrox, Sensual Woods, White Patchouli, Musk

How it wears

It is juicy and light to start, then turns soft and petal-like as the flowers come through. The eau de toilette strength makes it a relaxed daytime scent for work, lunches and warmer weather. The miniature is an easy way to get to know the scent, a neat stocking filler, or one to keep in a handbag.

Good to know

  • 5ml miniature
  • Eau de toilette
  • Made for women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Versace Yellow Diamond or Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Together

Michael Kors Pour Homme Eau de Parfum comes here as a 5ml miniature, an aromatic scent for men with a sea-air feel. Bergamot, lavender and pink pepper open it, then sea water, geranium and sage give a breezy, herbal heart. Ambergris, vetiver and patchouli add depth at the base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Bergamot, lavender, pink pepper
  • Heart notes: Sea water, geranium, sage
  • Base notes: Ambergris, vetiver, patchouli

How it wears

Lavender and sage give it a classic, clean-shaven character, and the sea note keeps it fresh for spring and summer days. Patchouli and vetiver bring an earthy, woody edge as it dries down, so it works for the office as well as weekends. A miniature is a simple way to get to know the scent, or to slip into a washbag.

Good to know

  • 5ml miniature
  • Eau de parfum
  • Made for men
  • Good as a stocking filler or travel size
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Armaf Hunter or Al Haramain L'Aventure

Fruity, spicy and warm, Ralph Lauren Polo Red Eau de Toilette Refillable is a men's scent in a generous 125ml bottle designed to be refilled. Cranberry, grapefruit and Italian lemon give a bright, tangy start before saffron and sage bring spice. The base of amber, coffee and woodsy notes rounds it off.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Cranberry, Grapefruit, Italian Lemon
  • Heart notes: Saffron, Sage
  • Base notes: Amber, Coffee, Woodsy Notes

How it wears

The red fruit and citrus make it energetic in the first minutes, and the coffee and amber add a darker, roasted note as it settles. As an eau de toilette it feels light enough for daytime, weekends and casual plans. In autumn the saffron and coffee come into their own on evenings out.

Good to know

  • 125ml refillable bottle
  • Eau de toilette
  • Made for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Ralph Lauren Polo Red Parfum or Antonio Banderas Diavolo

Ralph Lauren Polo Red Parfum takes the Polo Red name in a different direction: a parfum for men built on bergamot, blood orange and pink pepper. Its heart of orris, absinthe and lavender is herbal and slightly powdery, resting on musk, cedar and opoponax. It comes in a 75ml bottle.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Bergamot, Blood Orange, Pink Pepper
  • Heart notes: Orris, Absinthe, Lavender
  • Base notes: Musk, Cedar, Opoponax

How it wears

A parfum has a higher concentration of fragrance oils, which gives the orris and opoponax a dense, resinous depth. The blood orange keeps the opening bright, so it is not too heavy for smart office wear. It is best on cooler days, formal events and evenings when you want something polished.

Good to know

  • 75ml spray
  • Parfum
  • Made for men
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Ralph Lauren Polo Red Eau de Toilette or Al Haramain L’Aventure Intense

Moschino I Love Love in a 4.9ml miniature is a bright, citrus eau de toilette for women. Grapefruit, orange, lemon and red currant give a sparkling, juicy start. A heart of sugar cane, bulrush, lily of the valley, tea rose and a pinch of cinnamon leads to musk, cedar and thanaka wood.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Grapefruit, orange, lemon, red currant
  • Heart notes: Sugar cane, bulrush, lily of the valley, tea rose, cinnamon
  • Base notes: Musk, cedar, thanaka wood

How it wears

It is cheerful and easy, the kind of scent for sunny days, holidays and casual plans with friends. The sugar cane and rose round off the citrus so it never feels sharp, and the soft woods keep it light. Eau de toilette strength suits a playful daytime fragrance like this.

Good to know

  • 4.9ml miniature
  • Eau de toilette
  • Made for women
  • A small size for a handbag or a stocking
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: DKNY Be Delicious duo or Guess Mykonos Breeze body mist

Mugler Angel Elixir is a warm, sweet eau de parfum for women, presented in the refillable star bottle. Pink pepper opens it with a little spice, then a bouquet of ylang-ylang, orange blossom and jasmine leads into a base of Bourbon vanilla and amber. It is a floral scent with a rich, gourmand-leaning finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Pink Pepper
  • Heart notes: Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Sandalwood
  • Base notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Amber Xtreme

How it wears

The white flowers keep it bright at first, while vanilla and amber give it a deep, cosy warmth as it settles. That makes it a natural choice for autumn and winter evenings, dinners out and special occasions. As a Mugler Angel Elixir eau de parfum, it carries a higher concentration of fragrance oils than an eau de toilette.

Good to know

  • Available in 50ml and 100ml
  • Refillable bottle
  • Eau de parfum
